findings.failure_path: Modify an owner executable with added Ruby or shell lines, or add a behavioral instruction not formatted as a list item, without withdrawing any claim. Submit the owner's only ledger row as source-refuted with observed-failure:no, an arbitrary URL, and a pointer to any existing heading. owner_adds_normative_rule returns false because the additions do not match the list-item-plus-normative-verb proxy; source_refuted becomes true, all_rows_source_refuted lifts the RED floor, and the unrelated behavior change falsely passes.
findings.smallest_fix: Require source-refuted owner diffs to contain an actual deletion and reject every added owner-package line, or narrowly allow only separately identified reference prose while rejecting additions to SKILL.md and all executable/non-Markdown files. Add regression cases for a script change, a non-list behavioral instruction, and no withdrawal.

skipped_clients.reason: claude belongs to the implementer model family

concern_results.conclusion: Failed: source-refuted does not verify a withdrawal or pure deletion; it only rejects added lines matching a narrow list-item-plus-normative-verb shape.
The shared gate can falsely approve arbitrary executable or non-list behavioral changes under author-supplied source-refuted evidence.

Change an owner script or add a non-list instruction, add one source-refuted row with observed-failure:no, any URL, and a resolvable pointer; no normative list line is detected and the owner RED floor passes.
Cases G and H add Markdown list rules, so they do not fail against executable changes, non-list instructions, or a source-refuted declaration with no withdrawn line.
Status parsing is additive, but the new exemption weakens the existing owner-level evidence contract for every skill package containing scripts or non-list behavioral text.
No irreversible data migration is present, but the shared gate is not release-ready while this false-green path remains.
The bypass returns a successful gate result, so operators receive no diagnostic indicating that unrelated behavioral changes lacked RED evidence.
Containment fails because a syntactic Markdown-rule proxy is promoted to proof that the entire owner package has no unvouched behavioral remainder.
